purpose.text: Remove the wax and bring the section to water: xylene twice, then down the ethanol series to distilled water. Sections must look wet and even, with no cloudy wax left.

quantities.reagent: xylene (two jars), 100% ethanol (two jars), 95% ethanol, 70% ethanol, distilled water
quantities.time: xylene 5 + 5 min; ethanol 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 min; distilled water 3 changes of 1 min

purpose.text: The first exposure of the section to silver: 20% silver nitrate, 20 min, in the dark. Sections turn faintly yellow to light brown. Keep this jar: the ammoniacal silver is made from it.

quantities.reagent: 20% silver nitrate (10 g in 50 ml distilled water), made the same day in a brown or foil-wrapped jar; remake after 10 to 15 slides

purpose.text: Rinse in distilled water after the first silver bath, 3 changes of 1 min each, before the ammoniacal silver.

steps.title: Make the ammoniacal silver, then the second impregnation

purpose.text: In the hood, with gloves and goggles: into the silver nitrate jar from the first bath, add concentrated ammonium hydroxide one drop at a time while swirling. It turns brown and cloudy, then clears. Stop at the first moment it is completely clear, add 2 more drops, and filter it if it stays faintly cloudy; extra ammonia weakens the stain. Then the second impregnation: slides in, 15 min, in the dark. Sections turn tan to brown. Keep this jar: development happens in it.

quantities.reagent: ammoniacal silver: the 20% silver nitrate from the first bath plus concentrated (28 to 30%) ammonium hydroxide, roughly 7 to 10 ml per 50 ml, made right before use and used once
quantities.concentration: 20% silver, titrated to just clear plus 2 drops

purpose.text: Between the ammoniacal silver and the developer: slides into ammonia water (3 drops of concentrated ammonium hydroxide in 50 ml water) for 1 to 5 min. They wait here while the developer is added to the silver jar.

quantities.reagent: ammonia water: 3 drops of concentrated ammonium hydroxide in 50 ml distilled water, made right before use

purpose.text: Reduction of the impregnated silver to visible deposits. Add 3 drops of developer stock to the ammoniacal silver jar and swirl; slides in, in the dark, timer on. From 1 min, pull a slide every 30 to 60 s and look under the microscope: stop when axons, plaque neurites and tangles are black and the background is still tan, typically 1 to 5 min and never past 10; write down the time. Dark brown everywhere means too long. Stop in ammonia water for 30 s to 1 min, then distilled water, 3 changes of 1 min.

quantities.reagent: developer stock: 20 ml formaldehyde (37 to 40%), 100 ml water, 0.5 g citric acid, 1 drop concentrated nitric acid, made in the hood the same day and discarded after use; then ammonia water and distilled water to stop
quantities.concentration: 3 drops of stock per 50 ml of ammoniacal silver (about 9 drops for 150 ml)
quantities.time: 1 to 5 min typical, judged under the microscope, at most 10; stop in ammonia water 30 s to 1 min, then water 3 changes of 1 min

purpose.text: Optional: 0.2% gold chloride for 5 min, then distilled water for 1 min. It turns the stain from brown-black to gray-black.

quantities.reagent: 0.2% gold chloride (0.2 g in 100 ml water), made ahead; keeps for months in the dark

purpose.text: 5% sodium thiosulfate for 2 min. This removes silver that was never reduced, so the slide stops changing.

quantities.reagent: 5% sodium thiosulfate (5 g in 100 ml water), made ahead; keeps for weeks at room temperature

steps.title: Wash, dehydrate, clear and mount, then clean up

purpose.text: Distilled water, 3 changes of 1 min; then 95% ethanol, 100% ethanol twice and xylene twice, 2 min each; coverslip with resinous medium. Clean up at once: ammoniacal silver and developer mix to the silver waste, every jar that held silver rinsed the same hour, and the sheet filled in while you remember.

quantities.reagent: distilled water; 95% and 100% ethanol; xylene (two jars); xylene-based resinous mounting medium and coverslips
quantities.time: water 3 changes of 1 min; ethanol 2 + 2 + 2 min; xylene 2 + 2 min
